data.name: DuplicateTypeNameMessageFormat
data.value: There are multiple types named '{0}'. Source was generated for the first one detected. Use 'YamlSerializableAttribute.TypeInfoPropertyName' to resolve this collision.

data.name: DuplicateTypeNameTitle
data.value: Duplicate type name.

data.name: TypeNotSupportedMessageFormat
data.value: Did not generate serialization metadata for type '{0}'.

data.name: TypeNotSupportedTitle
data.value: Did not generate serialization metadata for type.

data.name: ContextClassesMustBePartialMessageFormat
data.value: Derived 'YamlSerializerContext' type '{0}' specifies JSON-serializable types. The type and all containing types must be made partial to kick off source generation.

data.name: ContextClassesMustBePartialTitle
data.value: Derived 'YamlSerializerContext' types and all containing types must be partial.

data.name: MultipleYamlConstructorAttributeFormat
data.value: Type '{0}' has multiple constructors annotated with 'YamlConstructorAttribute'.

data.name: MultipleYamlConstructorAttributeTitle
data.value: Type has multiple constructors annotated with YamlConstructorAttribute.

data.name: MultipleYamlExtensionDataAttributeFormat
data.value: Type '{0}' has multiple members annotated with 'YamlExtensionDataAttribute'.

data.name: MultipleYamlExtensionDataAttributeTitle
data.value: Type has multiple members annotated with YamlExtensionDataAttribute.

data.name: DataExtensionPropertyInvalidFormat
data.value: The data extension property '{0}.{1}' is invalid. It must implement 'IDictionary<string, YamlElement>' or 'IDictionary<string, object>', or be 'YamlObject'.

data.name: DataExtensionPropertyInvalidTitle
data.value: Data extension property type invalid.

data.name: FastPathPolymorphismNotSupportedTitle
data.value: 'YamlDerivedTypeAttribute' is not supported in 'YamlSourceGenerationMode.Serialization'.

data.name: FastPathPolymorphismNotSupportedMessageFormat
data.value: Type '{0}' is annotated with 'YamlDerivedTypeAttribute' which is not supported in 'YamlSourceGenerationMode.Serialization'.

data.name: YamlStringEnumConverterNotSupportedTitle
data.value: The non-generic 'YamlStringEnumConverter' requires dynamic code.

data.name: YamlStringEnumConverterNotSupportedMessageFormat
data.value: The member '{0}' has been annotated with 'YamlStringEnumConverter' which is not supported in native AOT. Consider using the generic 'YamlStringEnumConverter<TEnum>' instead.

data.name: YamlConverterAttributeInvalidTypeTitle
data.value: The 'YamlConverterAttribute.Type' contains an invalid or inaccessible argument.

data.name: YamlConverterAttributeInvalidTypeMessageFormat
data.value: The 'YamlConverterAttribute' type '{0}' specified on member '{1}' is not a converter type or does not contain an accessible parameterless constructor.

data.name: DerivedYamlConverterAttributesNotSupportedTitle
data.value: Attributes deriving from YamlConverterAttribute are not supported by the source generator.

data.name: DerivedYamlConverterAttributesNotSupportedMessageFormat
data.value: The custom attribute '{0}' deriving from YamlConverterAttribute is not supported by the source generator.

data.name: YamlUnsupportedLanguageVersionTitle
data.value: C# language version not supported by the source generator.

data.name: YamlUnsupportedLanguageVersionMessageFormat
data.value: The System.Text.Yaml source generator is not available in C# {0}. Please use language version {1} or greater.

data.name: YamlSerializableAttributeOnNonContextTypeTitle
data.value: Types annotated with YamlSerializableAttribute must be classes deriving from YamlSerializerContext.

data.name: YamlSerializableAttributeOnNonContextTypeMessageFormat
data.value: The type '{0}' has been annotated with YamlSerializableAttribute but does not derive from YamlSerializerContext. No source code will be generated.

data.name: TypeContainsRefLikeMemberTitle
data.value: Type includes ref like property, field or constructor parameter.

data.name: TypeContainsRefLikeMemberFormat
data.value: The type '{0}' includes the ref like property, field or constructor parameter '{1}'. No source code will be generated for the property, field or constructor.

data.name: YamlIgnoreConditionAlwaysInvalidOnTypeTitle
data.value: 'YamlIgnoreCondition.Always' is not valid on type-level 'YamlIgnoreAttribute' annotations.

data.name: YamlIgnoreConditionAlwaysInvalidOnTypeFormat
data.value: The type '{0}' has been annotated with 'YamlIgnoreAttribute' using 'YamlIgnoreCondition.Always' which is not valid on type declarations. The attribute will be ignored.

data.name: UnionCaseTypesNotClassifiableTitle
data.value: Union case types cannot be unambiguously classified by JSON value type.

data.name: UnionCaseTypesNotClassifiableMessageFormat
data.value: Union type '{0}': {1}. Set YamlUnionAttribute.TypeClassifier to provide a custom classifier that can disambiguate.

data.name: UnionTypeShapeNotSupportedTitle
data.value: Union type shape is not a valid C# union.

data.name: UnionTypeShapeNotSupportedMessageFormat
data.value: Union type '{0}' does not match the C# union shape convention: it must declare at least one public single-parameter case constructor and a public instance property named 'Value' with type 'object'.

data.name: OpenGenericDerivedTypeCouldNotBeResolvedTitle
data.value: Open generic derived type could not be resolved for the polymorphic base type.

data.name: OpenGenericDerivedTypeCouldNotBeResolvedMessageFormat
data.value: The open generic derived type '{0}' could not be resolved for the polymorphic base type '{1}': {2}.

data.name: DerivedTypeIsNotSupportedTitle
data.value: Derived type is not a supported polymorphic derived type.

data.name: DerivedTypeIsNotSupportedMessageFormat
data.value: Specified type '{0}' is not a supported derived type for the polymorphic type '{1}'. Derived types must be assignable to the base type.

data.name: InferredDerivedTypeIsNotAccessibleTitle
data.value: Inferred derived type is less accessible than the polymorphic base type.

data.name: InferredDerivedTypeIsNotAccessibleMessageFormat
data.value: The inferred derived type '{0}' is less accessible than the polymorphic base type '{1}'. Inferred derived types must be at least as accessible as the base type.

data.name: DerivedTypeDiscriminatorCollisionTitle
data.value: Derived types produce a duplicate type discriminator.

data.name: DerivedTypeDiscriminatorCollisionMessageFormat
data.value: The type discriminator '{0}' is specified more than once for the polymorphic type '{1}'. Derived types must correspond to unique discriminators.

data.name: InferClosedTypePolymorphismOnNonClosedTypeTitle
data.value: Inferred closed type polymorphism is enabled on a type that is not a closed type.

data.name: InferClosedTypePolymorphismOnNonClosedTypeMessageFormat
data.value: The type '{0}' enables YamlPolymorphicAttribute.InferClosedTypePolymorphism but is not a closed type, so no derived types can be inferred. Declare the type 'closed' or register its derived types using YamlDerivedTypeAttribute.

data.name: InferClosedTypePolymorphismWithExplicitDerivedTypesTitle
data.value: Inferred closed type polymorphism has no effect on a type that registers derived types explicitly.

data.name: InferClosedTypePolymorphismWithExplicitDerivedTypesMessageFormat
data.value: The type '{0}' enables YamlPolymorphicAttribute.InferClosedTypePolymorphism but also declares YamlDerivedTypeAttribute. Explicit registrations replace inference, so only the derived types declared explicitly are serialized polymorphically.

data.name: Polymorphism_OpenGeneric_Reason_NotAssignable
data.value: the derived type is not assignable to the base type

data.name: Polymorphism_OpenGeneric_Reason_UnificationFailed
data.value: the base type's arguments do not match the derived type's base specification

data.name: Polymorphism_OpenGeneric_Reason_UnboundParameter
data.value: the type parameter '{0}' of the derived type is not bound by the base type's arguments

data.name: Polymorphism_OpenGeneric_Reason_ConstraintViolation
data.value: the constraint on type parameter '{0}' is not satisfied by '{1}'

data.name: Polymorphism_OpenGeneric_Reason_AmbiguousMatch
data.value: the derived type matches the base type through multiple ancestors

data.name: YamlTagNotValidTitle
data.value: A YAML tag is reserved or not valid.

data.name: YamlTagNotValidMessageFormat
data.value: The YAML tag '{0}' on '{1}' cannot be used: {2}. A configured tag is a local tag ('!dog') or a global tag URI ('tag:example.com,2000:dog'); core tags ('!!str'), '!' and '?' are reserved.

data.name: YamlTagDuplicateTitle
data.value: A YAML tag is specified more than once.

data.name: YamlTagDuplicateMessageFormat
data.value: The YAML tag '{0}' is specified more than once for '{1}'. Each tag must select one type.

data.name: YamlTagMappingTypeNotSupportedTitle
data.value: A tag mapping names a type that cannot be created.

data.name: YamlTagMappingTypeNotSupportedMessageFormat
data.value: The type '{1}' that the YAML tag '{0}' maps cannot be created from a tag: an abstract class, an interface, an open generic, a Nullable<T>, a pointer or void.

data.name: YamlTagMappingTypeMappedTwiceTitle
data.value: A type is mapped by two YAML tags.

data.name: YamlTagMappingTypeMappedTwiceMessageFormat
data.value: The type '{0}' is mapped by the YAML tags '{1}' and '{2}'. A type is written with one tag, so it can be mapped once.
